本地 LLM 反向代理，自动重试，免费且开源: Local LLM reverse proxy, auto retry, free & open source
服务启动后本地端口才会开始转发请求，: Requests are forwarded only after the service starts,
选择上游服务商，通道将转发到该服务商的基础地址: Select the upstream provider; the channel forwards to its base URL
每个通道占用一个本地端口，可独立启停: Each channel owns one local port and can be started or stopped on its own
默认 8080，后续通道依次递增: Defaults to 8080; later channels increment from there
空闲超过设定分钟数后自动发送保活请求，避免上游会话过期: Sends a keep-alive request after the configured idle minutes so the upstream session does not expire
登录系统后自动运行代理，并恢复上次启用的通道。: Runs the proxy after sign-in and restores the channels that were enabled last time.
启动后不显示主窗口，仅保留托盘图标: Hides the main window on startup and keeps only the tray icon
点击关闭按钮不退出程序，代理继续在后台运行: Closing the window keeps the proxy running in the background
上游基础地址只需填到域名，路径与查询串会原样转发: Only the host is needed for the upstream base URL; path and query are forwarded as-is
包含连接、重试等待和接收响应；到时结束本次请求，不再重试。: Covers connecting, retry waits and receiving; the request ends when it expires and is not retried.
每次收到上游成功事件流的响应头后开始计时；空消息不重置。尚未转发内容时到期可重试: Starts after each successful upstream stream header; empty messages do not reset it. Expiring before any content was forwarded allows a retry; the total wait limit takes precedence.
当前通道，沿用本机默认配置: This channel, using the local default configuration
单独准备另一个供应商，开新通道: Prepare another provider separately via a new channel
立即停止所有通道，并丢弃所有处理中的请求: Stop every channel now and drop all in-flight requests
与首页选中的通道保持同步，切换后统计与保活随之更新: Stays in sync with the channel selected on Home; statistics and keep-alive follow the selection
立即停止监听，并丢弃所有处理中的请求: Stop listening now and drop all in-flight requests
仅作用于当前通道；超过该用量后清理后台会话，下轮重新创建，不会清理您的聊天记录。: Applies to this channel only; the background session is recreated once usage exceeds it. Your own chats are untouched.
选择准备方式：本通道沿用本机默认配置，或选定另一个供应商、输入其 Key，开一条: Choose how to prepare: keep this channel on the local default configuration, or pick another provider, enter its key and prepare through a new channel without touching this one. The choice also decides which configuration keep-alive uses afterwards.
终止当前通道的本次准备和后续重试。: Cancel this channel's current preparation and its retries.
仅当前通道 · 后台 Java 问答 · 250 题随机抽取: This channel only · background Java Q&A · random pick from 250 questions
与首页选中的通道保持同步: Follows the channel selected on Home
请先新增服务商与通道，收到成功回复后这里会显示缓存记录: Add a provider and a channel first; cache records appear after a successful reply
点击复制请求编号，可在日志文件中查找: Click to copy the request ID; search the log file with it
每个通道一个子目录，按天保存 jsonl 统计记录: One sub-folder per channel, one jsonl file per day
